{{Quote|As part of her efforts to lessen infighting and streamline decision-making, Empress Acina has consolidated the Dark Council down from twelve seats to five.|[[Lana Beniko]]|<ref name="SOTG" />}}
The '''Sphere of Civil Administration''' was one of the five [[Spheres of Influence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that was created by [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Darth Acina]] after the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]. The Sphere was the combination of the Spheres of [[Sphere of Production and Logistics|Production and Logistics]] and [[Sphere of Laws and Justice|Laws and Justice]] and was led by [[Dark Council]] member [[Darth Vowrawn]].<ref name="SOTG" />

==History==
The Sphere of Civil Administration was a power base of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] responsible for overseeing supply lines and weapons production, as well as enforcing internal laws. It was established by [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Darth Acina|Acina]] to lessen the infighting between [[Dark Council]] members, and was one of the five seats that succeeded the twelve [[Spheres of Influence]]. The Sphere was led by [[Darth Vowrawn]].

==Behind the scenes==
If the player character sides with the [[Galactic Republic]] during the events that take place on [[Iokath]], subsequently causing Acina's death, Vowrawn would ascend to become the Emperor. In the instance that this occurs, the Sphere of Civil Administration would then be helmed by [[Darth Shaar]].
